caseName: Gulf, Colorado & Santa Fe Railway Co. v. Thorn
caseNameFull: The Gulf, Colorado & Santa Fe Railway Company, in Error v. J. H. Thorn
summary: In error to the County Court of Sabine County, State of Texas.
attorneys: Mr. J. W. Terry, Mr. Gardiner Lathróp, Mr. A. H. Oulwell, Mr. A. B. Browne, Mr. Alexander Britton and Mr. Evans Browne for the plaintiff in error., No appearance for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment reversed with costs, and" cause remanded for further proceedings, upon the authority of Gulf, Colorado & Santa Fe Ry. Co. v. Dennis, 224 U. S. 503.
